Kraken
Major world boss
The Kraken is one of the seven major world bosses. It spawns in the Arcadian Sea at set times and stays spawned for 2hrs. It is one of the most valuable bosses in the game.
WhereArcadian Sea
The Kraken spawns in the western Arcadian Sea. There are 2 potential spawn locations.
WhenSet times
The Kraken spawns at Monday13:30 UTC-5 and Wednesday21:30 UTC-5.
Primal KrakenSaturdays
A stronger version, the Primal Kraken, rises only on Saturdays at Saturday16:30 UTC-5 and has new mechanics.

Preparation

RequiredShips
The Kraken is immune to all damage except Siege damage, so ships with cannons are needed to kill it. Bring at least 2 galleons with high grade ship cannons.

The fight

The Kraken is fought in the open water. Most players swim there, because PvP almost always breaks out and the few cannons on each ship fill up quickly.

AggroTank
The Kraken chases whoever holds aggro, usually a healer. The healer shells the Kraken first to gain aggro, then jumps into the water and keeps it by healing. They tank the Kraken away from the ships so the ships can shell it safely. Nothing but Siege damage hurts the Kraken, so cannons and healing are the only ways to hold its attention.
ShipsSiege damage
Galleons with high grade ship cannons deal the damage. Aim for 2 or more galleons shelling the Kraken.
Kraken's SlamAvoid
A huge area attack that kills anyone caught inside it. Use a mount with an invincibility skill as soon as you see the Slam animation start. It has a 1 minute cooldown.
Kraken's GnawBig hit
Charges at its target and deals a big hit of Siege and Magic damage around it, which also inflicts Electric Shock. It has a 15 second cooldown.
Kraken Ink SplashPull
Pulls everyone nearby towards the Kraken. It has a 45 second cooldown.
Kraken's TsunamiAggro swap
Dives forward and deals Magic damage to its target and four other enemies, who are hit with the Electrocution debuff. When it ends the aggro moves to a random player within 200m for 20 seconds. It has a 45 second cooldown.
Kraken's FrenzyUnder 30%
Once the Kraken is below 30% health it casts Frenzy, which greatly increases its health regeneration, turn speed and all damage except Siege damage for 5 minutes.
Tips
  • Keep the player holding aggro alive in the water.
  • Have 2 or more galleons with high grade cannons ready before the fight starts.
  • Watch for the Slam animation or cast and dodge it with an invincibility mount.
